articles.title: Switch 2 Update Secretly Makes Digital Game Sharing Much Better
articles.summary: Everyone is focused on VRR (variable refresh rate) support for Switch 2 while docked. But the latest system update just provided a notable quality-of-life improvement for people--especially families--who own multiple Switch 2 and Switch consoles.
body: For example, say your child is playing Super Mario Bros. Wonder on your old Switch OLED, but you want to play it on your Switch 2. You both can actually play the title simultaneously by turning off Wi-Fi on the original hybrid console. Then, on your Switch 2, you can utilize an online license to jump around as the mustached plumber, too. We tested this out successfully.

This also helps a lot between manually sending virtual game cards back and forth between Switch and Switch 2 systems. Now I can just start say, Blasphemous, on either system without having to actually send it from the previous place to a new one. Sure, it's not as smooth as using apps across Apple devices, but it's a step in the right direction.

Here's Nintendo's official language for the version 23.0.0 update, which incorporates Switch 2 and Switch. "When starting software, if a virtual game card cannot be ejected from another console because it is powered off or otherwise not connected to the internet, there will be a prompt to start the software using an online license."
points: Everyone is focused on VRR (variable refresh rate) support for Switch 2 while docked.
But the latest system update just provided a notable quality-of-life improvement for people--especially families--who own multiple Switch 2 and Switch consoles.

articles.title: A Whisper of Fall: Jinyiwei Brings Serious Martial-Arts Spectacle to Soulslikes | IGN Preview
articles.summary: A Whisper of Fall: Jinyiwei does an impressive job of drawing players into its world of martial-arts action, and I appreciated that it really leaned into the vertical exploration.
body: In the wake of this year’s Gamescom, it's been very clear that a wide assortment of new action titles have been looking to make their mark, especially in the soulslike sub-genre. One game in particular that's aiming high is the upcoming action-RPG A Whisper of Fall: Jinyiwei, which brings fast wuxia-inspired combat and spectacle-driven set-piece encounters to the historical Ming Dynasty setting.

We recently got some hands-on time with an early build of this soulslike action-RPG, which blends tense, martial-arts style action from the school of Black Myth: Wukong to the parkour-style action-platforming from Assassin's Creed. So far, A Whisper of Fall: Jinyiwei has a promising hook and serious style that makes a decent first impression, and hopefully it can build on that excitement from here.

articles.title: Death Stranding Franchise Likely Barely Broke Even, Could Explain Sony Dropping Physint – Analyst
articles.summary: With Sony no longer involved in the production of Hideo Kojima's Metal Gear Solid spiritual successor, Physint, people are wondering why the PlayStation company decided to part ways with the veteran game designer's upcoming game.
body: Why would it take another loss in the court of public opinion? Reportedly, Kojima's recent games haven't been big earners for Sony, which could be why Sony decided to cease funding for Physint.

According to a Bloomberg report, people familiar with the project have expressed concerns about Physint's development, as it has reportedly missed deadlines and could be going over budget. With Physint potentially being a timed exclusive for PlayStation, it's claimed that the company was reluctant to invest hundreds of millions of dollars in a game it would not own.

Alinea Analytics' Rhys Elliott also weighed in on the situation, saying, "From a strictly financial perspective, though, I can understand Sony's position. In a vacuum, anyway. PR and optics still matter. Ballpark math: word on the street is that the first Death Stranding cost about $100 million to make, and the second somewhere in the $150 million – $200 million ballpark (longer dev cycle, COVID, and all that). Depending on marketing overhead and the opportunity cost of pulling those Guerrilla developers onto Death Stranding, the franchise has almost certainly broken even--but not by much."

articles.title: Emberville Is a Charming Blend of Stardew Valley and Diablo | IGN Preview
articles.summary: What is here is already an impressive start. Between the mastery and class skill trees, loot, and stat points to distribute, Emberville already appeals to my love of ARPGs, while its gathering and crafting systems have the potential to appeal to a whole different crowd too, like my wife, who is a…
body: Described by many as “Diablo meets Stardew Valley,” Cygnus Cross’ debut title, Emberville, is just a little over a month out from welcoming players to check it out. IGN recently had the chance to get an early look, fighting through some mobs, meeting some of its NPCs, and even testing our mettle against an imposing spider boss. All while getting little teases and tastes of the crafting and character depth that we can look forward to when it enters early access in October.

While most of the time was spent throwing hands, I did still try each of the various weapons. Everything from the sword’s swishes and swooshes to the bow's charged shot had a good impact and feel to them, and I appreciated how I could use the staff to either bludgeon foes across the head or blast them with magic. And each of them comes with their own mastery trees that will unlock even stronger attacks should I fight with them, just like with the knuckles. These mastery trees extend not just to weapons either; with the other masteries you can invest in, such as armor, alchemy, and resource gathering, each offering their own benefits.

articles.title: Grand Theft Auto: Vice City – The Legacy Review
articles.summary: The original, legendary GTA: Vice City remains an irresistible experience in 2026 thanks to its unrivalled personality and style, and its sonically unmistakable soundtrack.
body: Over the next few months, I’m going to be taking a look back at each of the core Grand Theft Auto games and replaying them in the lead-up to the arrival of Grand Theft Auto 6. What we’ll be putting together won’t be traditional re-reviews, and they won’t come with any new IGN score, but they will re-examine what made each GTA remarkable upon the time of its release. By the end of the project, using GTA’s previously six-star wanted level, you should be able to get an idea of where each of these games roughly rank in my long-term love for this series.
Today it’s time to take these broken wings and learn to fly again in Grand Theft Auto: Vice City.

Grand Theft Auto: Vice City is emblematic of a long-extinct era. I’m not actually talking about its famous 1980s setting, though; I’m talking about the games industry at large. While we’ve had to patiently wait more than 12 years between GTA V and GTA VI, 2002’s Vice City arrived first on PlayStation 2 a mere 12 months after the genre-defining GTA III. Nothing as good as Vice City happens this rapidly anymore. And make no mistake – it is very, very good.
points: The original, legendary GTA: Vice City remains an irresistible experience in 2026 thanks to its unrivalled personality and style, and its sonically unmistakable soundtrack.

articles.title: Hot Toys’ Marvel’s Wolverine Figure Gets The Details Right, Right Down To The Hairy Silicone Arms
articles.summary: Logan is sporting a sharp look in Marvel's Wolverine, and if you're a fan of his latest video game incarnation's fashion sense, you can bring him home with this sixth-scale figure.
body: You'll have two options: either a $285 standard figure or a $375 deluxe edition. Both versions feature the same Wolverine body and design, which comes equipped with seamless silicone arms, an internal metal skeleton, and interchangeable components. There's no unmasked headsculpt, but you are getting alternate eye-plates and lower faces that allow you to change up Wolverine's expressions. You can also swap between two sets of cowl wing-flaps to show him off with varying stages of battle damage, and the textured suit is complemented by forearm gauntlets, a utility belt, and soft vinyl material boots.

You can even change up Logan's claws with sets of replica Adamantium, scarlet, and diamond blades, and they come with attachable translucent slashing motion effects. Finally, a carved katana ornament earned from the "Last Stand at Cold Pines" storyline mission is also included. If you're looking to create a diorama piece, then you'll want to grab the deluxe version, as it includes a statue bust of Omega Red in the display stand. While he doesn't have any articulation, there are two wire-embedded Carbonadium tentacles that you can coil around Logan.
points: Logan is sporting a sharp look in Marvel's Wolverine, and if you're a fan of his latest video game incarnation's fashion sense, you can bring him home with this sixth-scale figure.

It also adds that, "Unit includes OEM accessories and is packaged in a generic white or brown box."

Before the console's recent price increase kicked in, we did spot this same console offer at Woot for $399.99, but that was also a $50 difference in cost compared to the Switch 2's previous full price of $449.99. So overall, this remains quite a nice offer to jump on for a refurbished model. Again, it won't be around for long, and we may not see a console offer like it until Black Friday or Cyber Monday, so this is as good a time as any to grab it.

articles.summary: It feels like it's the 2021 PS5/Xbox Series X|S shortage all over again, as scalpers have once again begun targeting preorders for limited-edition consoles and accessories.
body: These controllers will start shipping out on November 19--the launch day for GTA 6--so each listing is well above the threshold of eBay's sales terms. While Sony has released several DualSense variants over the years, it looks like these new entries to the hardware line are benefiting from the hype and momentum of GTA 6 before it hits the scene in November.

Each controller variant features an eye-catching design, ranging from a shimmering, color-shifting finish to palm tree details molded directly into the controller body. articles.title: Lord of the Rings Inspired the Scale of Whalefall’s Suffocating Survival Story
articles.summary: Based on a novel by Pulitzer Prize-winning author and certified sicko Daniel Kraus, Whalefall stars Austin Abrams ( Weapons, Euphoria ) as Jay, whose mild-mannered dive off the California coast goes horribly wrong when a local sperm whale gives him the Jonah/Pinocchio treatment.
body: What happens when you’re out for a swim on a bright, sunny day and suddenly a whale the size of an eight-story building swallows you up while hunting down a flailing squid of equal might? We all think about it, but writer-director Brian Duffield went a step further and made this October’s Whalefall.

Ahead of its Oct. 16 release, I jumped on a call with Duffield to hear about his Ahab-like pursuit to capture the essence of Whalefall and if I could rightfully call the movie a two-hander when one of the main characters is also the central location.

That’s called scene-setting. Now let's talk about Whalefall. You and Daniel Kraus adapted Whalefall together. Having read his books and spoken to him recently about his absolutely wild year, my impression is the two of you have a very similar taste for inverting tropes and going as hard as humanly possible to execute on a premise. How did you wind up making this film with him?

articles.title: Pokémon Go and EA FC could be "under one roof", as EA and Saudi-owned Savvy Games Group reportedly considering merger
articles.summary: Saudi Arabia's Public Investment Fund (PIF) is reportedly considering combining EA - which it acquired in a $55bn leveraged buyout earlier this year - with its Savvy Games Group, all under one banner.
body: Speaking to Bloomberg, unnamed sources familiar to the matter claimed the merger between the EA and Savvy Gaming Group is intended to "ensure better coordination between its assets". This comes roughly two months after the record-breaking leveraged buyout of EA was finally finalised, placing the creator of EA FC, Apex Legends, Battlefield 6, and more under new ownership.

Savvy Games Group is a PIF subsidiary that already owns Scopely (creator of Pokémon Go ) and various esports companies like ESL, as well as a variety of partial stakes in Capcom, Nintendo, Koei Tecmo, and others. It has been the spearhead of Saudi Arabia's expansion into the video game industry for many years, but was notably not used to buy out EA earlier this year.

Savvy Games Group is also currently planning to acquire Moonton, a Chinese mobile gaming company, for $6bn. However, Bloomberg reports this is unlikely to go ahead until the merger between EA and Savvy Games Group happens. Both EA and the PIF declined to provide official comment to Bloomberg when asked.

articles.title: Prison Break Is Officially Back as Hulu Reveals Series Reboot
articles.summary: One of Fox’s most popular TV shows of all time is coming back under Disney. Hulu revealed a first look at Prison Break: Black Creek, a spin-off series set in the same universe as the original. The series is now in production and is “coming soon” to Hulu and Disney Plus.
body: While the teaser doesn’t give a lot to go on, Deadline provides the following description: “A soldier-turned-corrections officer takes a job at one of the deadliest prisons in America to prove just how far she’ll go for someone she loves.” The show will take place at the fictional Black Creek Penitentiary.

Elgin James ( Mayans M.C., The Outlaws ) is Black Creek ​​​​​​'s showrunner. The teaser video reveals that he will also direct, with Vanessa Joy Smith handling cinematography. Dawn Olmstead, who executive produced the original series, returns to that role, while Disney-owned 20th Television is handling production.

As for the cast, Black Creek stars Drake Rodger ( The Winchesters ) as Tommy, Clayton Cardenas ( Mayans M.C.) as Michael “Ghost,” JR Bourne ( Teen Wolf ) as Junior, Georgie Flores ( Famous in Love ) as Andrea, and Myles Bullock ( BMF ) as Darius “Red.” Noah Emmerich ( Murdaugh: Death in the Family, Dark Winds ) will play Callum Faulls, a West Virginia power broker.

articles.title: 'It would have been insanity to take no action' - Fiery opening statements reveal Rockstar's culture of secrecy as tribunal over sacked GTA 6 employees begins
articles.summary: Rockstar Games and the Independent Workers Union of Great Britain (IWGB) have traded blows in fiery opening statements during the final employment tribunal hearing, relating to the sudden firing of 31 Rockstar North employees nearly a year ago.
body: In their opening statements - made as the hearing got underway in Glasgow, Scotland, yesterday, and shared in full with Eurogamer - the opposing organisations outlined a case hinging on a private IWGB Discord server and what was and wasn't talked about there. It's on this Discord server that hundreds of Rockstar employees hoped to organise and create a legally recognised Rockstar union, but it's also here that Rockstar alleged confidential information was disclosed.

The 31 fired Rockstar North employees, represented by the IWGB, claimed Rockstar was "clandestinely monitoring" this Discord server through a "mole" since "at least" February 2024, but that Rockstar only took punitive action days after membership numbers reached the pivotal 10 percent figure (of a larger workforce) needed for unions to be recognised by UK law.

articles.summary: Amazon's upcoming adaptation of the 1974 horror novel Carrie isn't even out yet, but it already has one very important fan heaping praise on the series. Stephen King, the legendary horror author whose career began with Carrie, has shared his glowing first impressions of the latest take on the…

Mike Flanagan is helming the Amazon adaptation, modernizing the classic story by bringing it into the world of smartphones and cyberbullying. While much of Carrie's characterization and the overarching plot will stay the same, the inclusion of modern technology promises to bring a new dimension to the familiar story.

Summer H. Howell stars as Carrie in the new series. She'll be joined by series regulars Samantha Sloyan ( The Pitt ) as Margaret White, Siena Agudong ( Resident Evil ) as Sue Snell, Amber Midthunder ( Prey ) as Miss Desjardin, Alison Thornton as Chris Hargensen, Joel Oulette as Tommy Ross, Josie Totah as Tina, Arthur Conti as Billy, Thalia Dudek as Emaline, and Matthew Lillard ( Scream, Man of Tomorrow ) as Principal Grayle. Series guest stars will include Michael Trucco, Crystal Balint, Kate Siegel, Rahul Kohli, Tim Bagley, and Heather Graham.

articles.title: 'Defying common wisdom', people have been buying more high-end graphics cards despite rising prices, with 12.5 million shipped last quarter alone
articles.summary: If you've been keeping up with the headlines, then you know gaming hasn't been Nvidia's main priority for some time now. Given that its data centre segment made $89 billion in Q2 of 2026 —an eye-watering 93% of the company's total revenue that quarter—it's not super surprising that Nvidia is all-in…
body: That's according to the latest report from John Peddie Research; even though Nvidia's market share did decrease by 0.01% last quarter, the company is still holding on to a 90% share of the graphics 'Add-in Board' (AIB) market. AMD has 8%, while Intel enjoys a 2% slice of the pie.

For those a little unclear, an 'add-in board' (AIB) can mean anything you plug into your PC to improve performance, and GPUs definitely fall into that category. When companies refer to AIB GPUs, they're typically distinguishing them from integrated ones like you'll find in laptops, for instance.

The JPR report adds that during the second quarter, the "growth of the global PC-based graphics add-in board market reached 12.5 million units." That's a 10% increase from the quarter before. Not only that, but the likelihood of someone picking up an 'add-in board' in addition to a desktop PC was up to 89%, a 23% quarter-over-quarter increase.

videos.title: Grand Theft Auto: Vice City - The Legacy Review
videos.summary: Grand Theft Auto: Vice City - The Legacy Review by Luke Reilly. Reviewed on PlayStation 2.
body: "To this day, the opening moments of GTA: Vice City remain one of my most memorable gaming experiences ever. After getting into your first car, you’ll immediately hear the unmistakable bass line of Michael Jackson’s Billie Jean. It’s a small but meaningful moment that instantly plunges you into the past and feels like a happy accident, but it wasn’t – it was engineered to always be Billie Jean. Everyone heard it. Or, at least, they did until later re-issues and remasters of the game unfortunately trimmed it from the soundtrack. Either way, I was completely enchanted by Vice City from that moment. In 2026? I still can’t get enough of it. With its wide variety of vehicles, weapons, and missions, its stacked cast of recognisable voices, and its unmatched atmosphere, Vice City may have gone backwards in time – but it was a huge stride forward for the series and one of my all-time favourites."
